population: all 309 frozen outcome-blind exact BGP transitions observed at >=3 RIPE RIS RRCs

definitions.authorization_history: union of every covering VRP authorizing the same origin ASN
definitions.continuous_interval: merge overlapping or day-adjacent inclusive date ranges
definitions.activation_lead: start of the continuous new-origin authorization interval covering the exact BGP transition date
definitions.retirement_linger: end of the continuous old-origin authorization interval covering the exact BGP transition date; later reauthorization after a gap is excluded
definitions.same_day_guardrail: historical RPKI data are date-granular; same-day BGP/ROA ordering is unresolved

enrichment_diagnostic.interpretation_activation: new-origin event-date authorization is stable across the prior enriched 185 and the newly added 124
enrichment_diagnostic.interpretation_retirement: the prior lifecycle-enriched 185 materially overrepresented long old-origin authorization persistence; retirement inference must use the full 309 panel

endpoint_consistency_audit.interpretation: frozen validator is retained as authority for exact-event ROV state; historical search is used for lifecycle interval reconstruction. They are not silently imputed into one another; discordance is source-specific and disclosed. In the discordant subset, the independent RIPE archive more often agrees with the history Boolean than with the frozen validator.

invalid_run_stability.interpretation: the event-start Invalid state is stable for every case used in the later-authorization Invalid-run analysis

paper_decision.recommended_wording: Historical authorization reconstruction found a matching new-origin authorization on the exact transition date in 133/309 cases; among those, 101 had begun at least one calendar day earlier. For the old origin, 153/309 had a matching authorization interval covering the transition date; among horizon-observable cases, 115/153 remained continuously authorized at 30 days, 87/126 at 90 days, and 39/76 at 180 days.

discarded_non_authoritative_intermediate: rpki_lifecycle_full309_v1 regression against inputs/rpki_exact185_policy_input_20261002.csv: that file contains 61 policy-stage rows, not the full prior185 authority

rpki_lifecycle_full309_regression_v2 direct lifecycle-field mismatch count against corrected exact artifact: the corrected artifact stores exact timing but not refined lifecycle fields, so blank-schema mismatches are non-scientific
rpki_lifecycle_full309_contiguous_v3 legacy_vs_contiguous_field_differences: exact input lacks legacy lifecycle columns, so these diagnostic counts are invalid and must not be cited
guardrails: ROA history is date-granular and cannot establish sub-day ordering.
The 309 cases are outcome-blind exact-transition cases; lifecycle RPKI fields were not used for selection.
Historical search reconstruction and frozen validator are separate sources with measured discordance; neither is silently substituted for the other.
Old-origin authorization persistence is not operator intent, routing persistence, stale configuration, or traffic impact.
Right-censored authorizations at the study cutoff are not treated as observed withdrawals.
